executive_summary: Canada is experiencing an unprecedented ransomware crisis with 101+ organizations compromised in the last 48 hours across all sectors. High-profile victims include Canada Goose (coinbasecartel), National Money Mart with a confirmed database leak (Everest), Eastern Townships School Board (Qilin), Peterborough Public Health (Lynx), and the Municipality of North Perth (worldleaks). The Qilin ransomware group alone is responsible for 20+ Canadian victims, followed by Play (11), Safepay (10), and Clop (13). Critical sectors hit include healthcare, education, public sector municipalities, financial services, and telecommunications—posing immediate risks to citizen data and essential services.

canada_landscape.summary: Canada is experiencing a severe ransomware wave with over 100 organizations compromised on July 2, 2026. Critical infrastructure targets include public health (Peterborough), education (Eastern Townships School Board, Teccart), municipalities (North Perth, MRC de Maskinongé), telecommunications (Eeyou Communications Network), and healthcare providers. No CCCS advisories were identified in the current feed.
canada_landscape.retailers: Canada Goose compromised by Coinbasecartel ransomware gang; Active Green + Ross and Kids & Company hit by Sinobi
canada_landscape.financial: National Money Mart Company breached by Everest ransomware with database leaked; Morison Insurance Brokers compromised by Sinobi; Trucash hit by Lynx; multiple accounting firms affected including Pewarchuk CPA (Play) and MG Chartered Professional Accountant (Qilin)

report_2w.executive_summary: Fortinet devices face critical credential leaks dubbed 'FortiBleed' with thousands of compromised credentials now exposed, prompting an official CCCS advisory. Multiple zero-day and actively exploited vulnerabilities are under attack: Oracle E-Business Suite, SimpleHelp (CVE-2026-48558), PTC Windchill (CVE-2026-12569), and Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN (CVE-2026-0257). Russian state-sponsored threat actors are conducting destructive attacks against Jaguar Land Rover and signal-phishing campaigns targeting Signal users. Widespread supply chain attacks hit npm and Go packages, deploying Python infostealers via VS Code tasks, while new phishing kits (Bluekit, AWS AiTM) bypass multi-factor authentication in real time.

canada_landscape.summary: Canada's Cyber Centre (CCCS) issued Alert AL26-014 on June 18, 2026, warning of 'FortiBleed'—a leak of thousands of compromised Fortinet device credentials affecting Canadian organizations. No specific breaches of major Canadian retailers or financial institutions were identified in this reporting period. DOJ seized 400 illegal FIFA World Cup streaming domains with Canadian connections.
